name: Horizon Sniper (Scout Archetype)
body:
Horizon Snipers train to strike even the furthest enemies with precision.

Controlling the battlefield while remaining an unseen threat.

Spotter (Ex)

At 1st level, the horizon sniper reduces the bonus to the DC of Perception checks due to distance by 1/2 their class level (to a minimum of +0 to the DC). Additionally, the penalty to ranged attacks from distance is reduced by the same amount, to a minimum of -0.

This ability replaces trapfinding.

Shot from Above (Ex)

Beginning with 3rd level, when making a ranged attack from a higher altitude than their target, the horizon sniper deals +2 damage. These attacks ignore cover unless there is a ceiling or cover above the target.

This ability replaces the fast movement gained at 3rd level.

Hidden Sniper (Ex)

Starting at 4th level, the horizon sniper reduces the penalty to Stealth checks to remain hidden while sniping by half their class level.

This ability replaces hit and run.

Arcing Shot (Ex)

Starting with 9th level, so long as there is 40 feet of vertical clearance between the horizon sniper and their target, they treat their maximum range increments as 15 range increments for projectile weapons and 7 range increments for thrown weapons.

This ability replaces improved hit and run.

Horizon Shot (Ex)

Starting with 11th level, as a standard action, the horizon sniper can make a single ranged attack and ignore all ranged penalties on the attack, though it is still restricted by the attack’s maximum range. This attack can be used in conjunction with Vital Strike and other similar feats or abilities.

This ability replaces the fast movement gained at 11th and 19th levels.
